description: SimNet TSHeat simulates the time-dependent hydraulic and thermal behaviour of district-heating networks. It includes storage modelling, asset databases, GIS support and outputs such as pressures, temperatures, heat losses and travel times. The provider is Fluid Systems. Coverage: Coverage is user-defined heat networks and scenario periods. Forecast outdoor temperatures and component schedules are inputs; accuracy depends on network data and calibration. Access: The official Polish product page and interoperability description were read. No software or brochure was downloaded. Licence and cost: The developer offers the software to customers and describes ongoing support. Prices, licence conditions and source-code rights require confirmation. Limitations: Claims of unlimited network size and measurement savings are provider claims, not independently verified performance evidence. For simulation it supports network operation, heat-storage sizing and assessment of supply interruptions. Related resources: model-pandapipes is a separate pipe-network modelling option. No compatibility or use by SimNet TSHeat was established.
